name: Manes

traits.name: Aggressive Carnage
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, the manes can move up to its Speed toward an enemy it can see.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

description: Manes are the lowest of demonkind, feral remnants of mortal souls consumed by the Abyss and twisted into mindless, ravenous husks that swarm in packs.
